# Lattice | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Performance and calibration | Main link validation of performance and calibration is used as “entry of personnel or candidate data - rules or approval processing - self-help of staff managers - results into reports or downstream systems”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Full OkR | The main link to verify the entry of data by personnel or candidates - rules or approval processing - self-help by the manager - results into the report or downstream system is OKR. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Participatory Action Plan | The participation action plan is based on “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results access reports or downstream systems”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Career development and pay cycles | The career development and remuneration cycle is validated on the basis of the main link, “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - employee manager self-help - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
